contract: Actionable alt-data axis for the Mastermind bot. Each signal: signal_score 0-100 (composite of weighted convergence + brain conviction + price confirm − extension), action ∈ {ACCUMULATE,WATCH,AVOID}, direction ∈ {long,short,neutral}, source ∈ {brain,deterministic}. The bot sizes through its OWN risk framework; this is an input, not an order. Brain calls are graded vs SPY (see calibration). An extended name is never ACCUMULATE. trump_linked / affiliations flag actor ties. rolling_over names (off_high≤−15% AND 20d<0 AND below 50dma) appear in broken_signals only — crowd attention, NOT entries. entry_tier (T1/T2/T3) = validated confluence buy gate signal.
regime_read: Convergence is broad but uneven: the cleanest measured alignments are in AI/cloud demand, memory, telecom contracting, and an airline activist setup, while several other clusters lean heavily on sentiment or affiliation. With no scored outcomes in the desk track record, conviction remains deliberately low despite multiple five-channel signals [track_record].

calibration.note: No theses scored yet — the track record begins once the first check-by dates pass. Keep conviction modest until it does.

signals.thesis: Five channels align around enterprise AI distribution and developer adoption: app demand, GitHub momentum, model-download momentum and a large patent cluster reinforce the strategic partnership signal from Sam Altman [app_demand] [github_momentum] [hf_model_momentum] [patent_cluster] [actor:Sam Altman]. The shares are not extended at +13.8 percentage points versus SPY over 60 days, so the setup remains actionable rather than chased.
second_order: NVDA — cloud AI adoption implies continued accelerator demand
Data-center power and cooling infrastructure — greater model usage raises supporting capacity requirements
Enterprise software integrators — broader Microsoft AI deployment creates implementation work

falsifier.text: App demand and developer/model activity roll over while AI infrastructure spending continues to rise without corresponding cloud revenue acceleration.

signals.thesis: The memory-cycle read has four-way support from insider purchasing intensity, a sizable patent cluster, unanimous measured Stocktwits bullishness and a disclosed Ro Khanna affiliation [insider_mspr] [patent_cluster] [stocktwits_bull] [actor:Ro Khanna]. Government-grant acceleration is also present in the metrics, but it is not one of the scored convergence channels and is therefore only supplementary. At +6.9 percentage points versus SPY, MU is not extended.
second_order: Memory-equipment suppliers — stronger memory investment would support fabrication-tool demand
AI accelerators — rising high-bandwidth-memory demand is tied to accelerator deployments
Data-center hardware — memory-content growth benefits AI server supply chains

falsifier.text: Insider buying ceases and memory demand weakens before patent activity converts into commercial products.

signals.thesis: Only two channels align, but both are transaction-oriented: a four-member congressional buying cluster and sharply accelerating federal-contract activity [congress_cluster] [gov_contract_accel]. The flat 60-day relative return means the entry is not extended, but the narrow channel count limits conviction.
second_order: Telecom network equipment — sustained federal communications awards can pull through equipment demand
Cybersecurity services — government telecom deployments typically require security layers
Fiber construction contractors — network expansion can increase installation and maintenance work

falsifier.text: Federal contract awards normalize without follow-through and the congressional buying cluster dissipates.

signals.thesis: Clinical Phase 3 starts, an FDA label-expansion signal, lobbying activity and a special-situation flag form a coherent healthcare catalyst cluster [clinical_phase3_start] [fda_label_expansion] [lobbying] [special_situation]. However, three clinical halts are the strongest internal counter-signal, and the +23.5 percentage-point relative move versus SPY argues for watching catalyst progression rather than pressing the entry.
second_order: Clinical-research organizations — multiple Phase 3 starts can increase trial-services demand
Drug-manufacturing partners — successful label expansion can raise commercial production needs
Healthcare distributors — broader approved indications can expand downstream volumes

falsifier.text: Additional clinical halts emerge or the expected label expansion does not progress.

signals.thesis: The five-channel cluster combines model-demand momentum, a concentrated analyst-upgrade signal, elevated lobbying activity and a special-situation flag, with disclosed political ownership and affiliations adding an influence-graph cross-check [hf_model_momentum] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [lobbying] [special_situation] [actor:Nancy Pelosi]. Its -3.8 percentage-point relative return versus SPY leaves the name non-extended, though the evidence does not isolate whether AWS or commerce is driving the signal.
second_order: NVDA — AWS AI workload growth supports accelerator demand
Data-center power infrastructure — expanding cloud-model usage requires additional capacity
Cloud software vendors — stronger AWS activity can lift its surrounding software ecosystem

falsifier.text: Model momentum fails to translate into stronger AWS usage while the analyst-upgrade cluster reverses.

broken_signals.thesis: The airline setup combines an activist 13D, strong app demand, a disclosed Paul Singer affiliation and a favorable Trump-linked signal [activist_13d] [app_demand] [actor:Paul Singer] [trump]. The -7.1 percentage-point relative return versus SPY leaves room for operational or governance catalysts to be recognized, but the signal depends heavily on activist execution.
second_order: Aircraft maintenance providers — improved fleet utilization can raise maintenance demand
Airport service vendors — stronger passenger throughput supports ground and terminal services
Domestic travel platforms — healthier airline demand can increase booking volumes

falsifier.text: The activist campaign produces no measurable governance or operating change and app demand fails to translate into improved traffic.

disclaimer: An AI reading of the desk's own deterministic convergence — accountable and checkable, not a guarantee. Every call cites the channels/actors it is based on, is graded vs SPY over the horizon, and can be wrong or overconfident. The Mastermind sizes it through its own risk framework; treat as odds, not a forecast.
